title: Emulating the Darcy Solution Operator by Heat-Semigroup Functional Calculus and Pointwise Products
summary: We approximate the solution operator $(a,f)\mapsto u$ of $-\operatorname{div}(a\nabla u)=f$ by operator networks whose only primitives are heat-semigroup functions of a fixed reference operator and pointwise products. The main result is an emulation theorem on strongly local Dirichlet spaces with a spectral gap and a Bakry--Émery bound $\mathrm{BE}(-K,\infty)$: an explicit scheme reaches $\dot H^1$-error $\varepsilon$ uniformly over coefficients with bounded carré du champ and bounded generator image and over $L^2$ data, with parameters depending only on the coefficient bounds, the accuracy…
